events.verdict: Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly places a hand to Durant's (PHX) chest before correcting to a legal guarding position for the rest of Durant's (PHX) drive.
Booker (PHX) briefly has an arm around Antetokounmpo (MIL) during the rebound and the two players get tangled up.
Durant (PHX) moves forward into Kuzma (MIL), initiating illegal body contact before he returns to the floor during his jump shot attempt.
Durant (PHX) contests Trent Jr.'s (MIL) jump shot attempt and makes contact with the ball and the ensuing contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.

Kuzma (MIL) absorbs the contact with Durant (PHX) at the start of his drive. As Durant stops short and releases, Kuzma loses his balance on his own accord and not as a result of any extension by Durant.

Durant (PHX) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) jockey for position prior to when the ball is at the inbounder's disposal and the contact is marginal. During the throw-in, the two players briefly engage and are both able to move freely.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the ruling on the floor of a defensive foul on Durant (PHX) stands as called. Although Lopez (MIL) catches the ball inside the lower defensive box and therefore Durant is allowed to be positioned inside the restricted area, Durant jumps forward into Lopez and initiates illegal body contact.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) wraps his arm around Durant's (PHX) hip as he reaches in and he initiates illegal contact that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly has an arm around Durant (PHX) before immediately sliding it off.
Ighodaro (PHX) has his arms extended as Lopez (MIL) defends the throw-in, but the contact is marginal and does not prevent Lopez from disengaging.
Durant (PHX) legally contests Lopez's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
